## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: When the launcher reports saturation or is unreachable past the threshold, a...

The system SHALL ensure that when the launcher reports saturation or is unreachable past the threshold, a dispatch is placed on a cloud session and its result returns through the same inbox and dispatch-result schema.

#### Scenario: When the launcher reports saturation or is unreachable past the threshold, a...

WHEN `add-cloud-overflow-placement-for-dispatches` is implemented
THEN When the launcher reports saturation or is unreachable past the threshold, a dispatch is placed on a cloud session and its result returns through the same inbox and dispatch-result schema.

### Requirement: A placement test proves no dispatch is placed on cloud while the GX10 has...

The system SHALL ensure that a placement test proves no dispatch is placed on cloud while the GX10 has free capacity.

#### Scenario: A placement test proves no dispatch is placed on cloud while the GX10 has...

WHEN `add-cloud-overflow-placement-for-dispatches` is implemented
THEN A placement test proves no dispatch is placed on cloud while the GX10 has free capacity.

### Requirement: Every cloud placement is recorded in the dispatch result's degradations[]...

The system SHALL ensure that every cloud placement is recorded in the dispatch result's degradations[] and appears as cloud consumption in the governor.

#### Scenario: Every cloud placement is recorded in the dispatch result's degradations[]...

WHEN `add-cloud-overflow-placement-for-dispatches` is implemented
THEN Every cloud placement is recorded in the dispatch result's degradations[] and appears as cloud consumption in the governor.
